caveats: VANI used one persona for everyone, so persona-option effects are inferred from behaviours and segments, not measured directly.
Summary tags come from AI-written summaries matched with keywords; expect some noise.
Only variant (bot_version) findings compare scripts side by side; all other findings are correlational.
Turn-level transcripts exist for 455 of 9657 calls; transcript findings are directional.

findings.title: Meeting rate when 'early_drop' happens
findings.statement: Calls tagged 'early_drop' fixed 0.0% meetings (n=4486) vs 20.8% without (n=5171).
findings.implication: The first 20 seconds decide the call: personalise the opening and keep it short for drop-prone sellers.

findings.title: Meeting rate when 'busy' happens
findings.statement: Calls tagged 'busy' fixed 5.0% meetings (n=905) vs 11.8% without (n=8752).
findings.implication: Detect rush live; skip the pitch and offer two concrete slots.

findings.title: Meeting rate when 'confused' happens
findings.statement: Calls tagged 'confused' fixed 2.6% meetings (n=154) vs 11.3% without (n=9503).
findings.implication: Detect confusion live; slow down, simplify, one idea per sentence.

findings.title: Meeting rate when 'frustrated' happens
findings.statement: Calls tagged 'frustrated' fixed 7.7% meetings (n=78) vs 11.2% without (n=9579).
findings.implication: Detect frustration live; acknowledge, cut length, go straight to the ask.

findings.title: Meeting rate when 'bot_question' happens
findings.statement: Calls tagged 'bot_question' fixed 2.7% meetings (n=149) vs 11.3% without (n=9508).
findings.implication: Answer 'are you a bot?' honestly and warmly, then continue; reassure strategy.

findings.title: Meeting rate when 'price' happens
findings.statement: Calls tagged 'price' fixed 19.6% meetings (n=1354) vs 9.8% without (n=8303).

findings.title: Meeting rate when 'visit' happens
findings.statement: Calls tagged 'visit' fixed 62.6% meetings (n=804) vs 6.5% without (n=8853).

findings.title: Meeting rate when 'whatsapp' happens

findings.title: Meeting rate when 'not_interested' happens
findings.statement: Calls tagged 'not_interested' fixed 3.8% meetings (n=1051) vs 12.1% without (n=8606).

findings.title: Meeting rate when 'already_in_touch' happens
findings.statement: Calls tagged 'already_in_touch' fixed 3.7% meetings (n=81) vs 11.2% without (n=9576).

findings.title: Meeting rate when 'language_issue' happens
findings.statement: Calls tagged 'language_issue' fixed 8.6% meetings (n=35) vs 11.2% without (n=9622).
